text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, we're definitely going for the 
"Kaiser Parfait", right?! I made sure to 
get a reservation!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I have been eagerly 
anticipating what kind of parfait the 
"Emperor" would create.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! After all, it's the 
'Emperor'! It's gotta be a totally special 
parfait!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Rather than cute, it's definitely gotta be 
cool, right! Stylish, kind of luxurious? 
Maybe it even has a crown on top or 
something~!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To express the dignity and nobility 
befitting an "Emperor" upon a single 
plate――I must take such a grand spirit 
fully upon myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Once again, my thanks for the inviting 
cool breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I were alone, even knowing that name, I 
surely never would have become the wind 
that heads toward it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The feelings carried by this spring gale 
have truly become the greatest gift of 
all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Because the moment I heard 
'Kaiser Parfait,' I just knew I had to 
share it with you, Zephyr♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, let's go, Zephyr! Let's conquer the 
"Emperor" together♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us journey forth along the 
friendly winds.
